{{Quote|In fact, calculations suggest only two options: here at Gromas, in the Perkell sector, or here, at Phindar, in the Mandalore sector.|Tarkin tries to predict where the ''Carrion Spike'' will refuel|<ref name="Tarkin">[[Tarkin (novel)|''Tarkin'']]</ref>}}
The '''Perkell sector''' was a [[sector]] located in [[the galaxy]]'s [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]] that contained the [[Gromas system|Gromas]], [[Kenari system|Kenari]], and [[Mooga system]]s among others.<ref name="Appendix" /> After the ''[[Carrion Spike]]'', the personal [[corvette]] of [[Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]], was [[Mission to Murkhana|stolen]] by a [[Berch Teller's rebel cell|rebel cell]] and used to [[Attack on Galidraan Station|attack]] the [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[space station]] [[Galidraan Station]], a [[Gromas Imperial depot|Imperial depot]] on Gromas was considered as one of only two potential refueling stations the corvette could visit. The corvette did not travel into the Perkell sector however, instead refueling at the planet [[Phindar]] in the [[Mandalore sector]].<ref name="Tarkin" />
